status: promising independently tested zero-shot candidate, not established logistic superiority
prompt:
You are a professional football (soccer) analyst.
The image shows a shot at the moment it is taken, drawn on a half pitch with the goal at the top.
Gold star = shooter. Blue circles = shooter's teammates. Red circles = opponents.
Orange square = opposing goalkeeper.
Estimate the probability that this shot results in a goal (expected goals, xG),
assuming an average professional finisher.
Reply with JSON only: {"xg": <number between 0 and 1>, "reason": "<one short sentence>"}
evidence: 150 new shots, 25 goals, 34 matches. 99% five-comparison-adjusted match interval supports lower Brier than Luna. Ranking/short-range/stability diagnostics also improved by point estimate.
next_validation: Another fixed unused-match cohort is needed before a general or baseline-superiority claim. No new runner or automatic stage is created.
